properties.text:
An asteroid strike compromised the ship, killing the lights and releasing a [color=#00ff00]deadly gas[/color] leak. Complete the objectives to restore operations and allow a maintenance crew to dock and repair the structural damage.

Controls:
- [color=#ffff00]\[Arrows][/color] : move around and jump
- [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] : interact with doors and objects
- [color=#ffff00]\[I][/color] : open inventory and objective menu

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] to start.
[color=#ffff00]Task:[/color] Place the fuse in the box to turn the lights back on.
